snippet.title: DOWNHILL Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNHILL is a unique 4th wall-breaking action RPG. Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433000/DOWNHILL/

Take control of a human girl named Fade and become her best friend or her worst enemy as you guide her down the mountain. Her fate is yours to decide, as well as the entire realm's.

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@downhillgame
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/downhillgame.bsky.social
